import { test } from 'node:test';
import { existsSync } from 'node:fs';
const systemCi = true;
test('acceptance: x', { skip: !systemCi && 'needs systemd' }, () => {});
const bootOk = existsSync(['', 'run', 'systemd', 'system'].join('/'));
test('acceptance: y (really needs systemd)', { skip: !bootOk && 'needs a booted init' }, () => { throw new Error('never runs anywhere'); });
